title: Fishing Rod Holder 4-Pack – Heavy-Duty Storage
descriptionHtml:
Keep your rods in order

Loose fishing rods tangle easily and take up space in the boat and the garage. Lines and lures catch on each other and it gets messy.

Four holders that keep things in order

With four sturdy holders, every rod gets its own place. Holds your rods securely in place.

Features

  • Four holders in one set
  • Sturdy construction that holds the rods steady
  • For beach, lake and boat fishing
  • Suits both pros and beginners

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
